cc:Work.dc:title: Test2: convergence
cc:Work.dc:description: {"caption": "Maximum observable changes normalized by the new backend requested target, not error bounds. NRG is finite-Lambda; zero keep sensitivity is an exact zero in the stored means. DMRG residuals show one checked root per branch; the doublet stops at chi768, the singlet continues to chi1024. One warm trial is not fresh independent-seed evidence.", "finite_indices": [0, 1, 2, 3, 4, 10, 11, 12], "maxima": [0.024726787645229037, 0.00010347006129120511, 305.60464487948406, 21.948901875127337, 0.04854601785617202, 0.25291778197208625, 4.211521585592257e-06, 0.0, 0.2688550956235116, 0.09817992152702172, 6.947270587445877e-05, 9.714521396749074e-08, 2.7755775419283838e-08], "nrg_indices": [5, 6, 7, 8, 9], "residual_tolerance": 1e-07, "residuals": {"doublet": {"bonds": [256, 512, 768], "values": [9.22794887726904e-06, 4.167929260031273e-07, 5.576931660740834e-08]}, "singlet": {"bonds": [256, 512, 768, 1024], "values": [2.431981422378417e-05, 1.1368578851321806e-06, 1.5190987625472183e-07, 3.3748672373759946e-08]}}}
